the net of gudgeons in the grass. <break time="0.8s" /> Where the little fish. <break time="0.8s" /> Were still shining and moving in the sun. <break time="0.8s" /> A weakness came over him. <break And then, at the officers command. <break time="0.8s" /> Twelve rifles fired as one. <break time="0.8s" /> The two friends fell to the ground together. <break time="0.8s" /> And the soldiers carried
